_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit the copy. config.json is
git-ignored so that credentials are never committed.
Any long command-line option may be used as a key here, without the
leading dashes. Options given on the command line override the file.
Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored, so they serve as comments.
_comment_required: Replace all four of these. The miner will not start otherwise.
_comment_devices: GPUs to use, by index as reported by 'vkminer --device-list'.
Omit or leave empty to use every device found.
_comment_optional: Shown with their default values; change or delete as you like.
